written.headline: Claude Code approval files expose company secrets on GitHub
written.summary: Apiiro researchers found that Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" feature can store database passwords and other credentials in local settings files that end up committed to public GitHub repositories. The researchers identified 1,122 public files containing secrets out of 104,185 examined public copies.

written.headline: After the midterms, things are looking rocky for Elon Musk and data centers
written.summary: Democrats won a historic victory in the midterm elections, leading to voter rejection of data centers in local ballot measures and the election of politicians like Texas governor-elect Gina Hinojosa who campaigned on restricting data centers. Tech commentator Sean O'Kane noted that Elon Musk received little return after donating half a billion dollars to Republicans while keeping his businesses headquartered in a state that turned heavily Democratic.

written.headline: Anthropic-backed PAC Public First spent $63M+ in 2026 midterms
written.summary: The Anthropic-backed AI safety super PAC Public First spent over $63 million during the 2026 midterm elections. Ten of the 17 congressional candidates supported by the PAC won their races.
